_about: Published artifacts are immutable: a defective build can never be removed, only superseded by a higher build number and/or neutralised by a metadata patch in patches/. Both of those protect FUTURE solves only -- an existing pixi.lock keeps installing whatever it pinned, silently, forever. This list is the static, self-serve record of every build known to be defective, so anyone holding a lockfile can check it with tools/check_lock.py. Keyed by subdir, then by exact .conda filename; 'fixed_by' names the superseding build to re-lock onto.
